base_model.revision_note: base revision from the Winnow card

licence.notes: Apache-2.0 for the Winnow-12B weights (a merged LoRA fine-tune of Gemma 4 12B IT; the Gemma terms apply). The Winnow inference code is a patched llama.cpp (MIT, preserved).

jev_distillation.evidence: Card: "The training data and pipeline are private"; labels are synthetic scenarios and teacher-supervised examples. No statement on Jev/TypeSafe outputs.

installer_policy.reason: Open licence (apache-2.0). In the union of the open JevBench board's top 10 by Composite Score (#7). Runs only on NVIDIA Blackwell (sm_120) Linux with CUDA 13 runtime libraries, because the author's prebuilt server is built for sm_120 only.

readout.notes: Author's patched llama.cpp server (winnow-server) answers POST /v1/systemone natively, scoring the options without generating tokens.
readout.portable_notes: Needs the author's llama.cpp patches (classifier head, Gemma4 tied embedding); stock llama.cpp does not reproduce the readout. Only the author's Linux x86_64 CUDA 13 build for sm_120 is prebuilt; Apple Silicon needs a source build (not offered here).

variants.runtime: winnow-server (author's patched llama.cpp, prebuilt CUDA 13 release)

steps: Extract the winnow-inference runtime release v2026.10.06 (sha256 8829a53e...). Host needs glibc 2.38+, CUDA 13 runtime libs (libcudart/libcublas 13, libnccl 2) and an sm_120 GPU.
python3 scripts/winnow.py serve --model q8 --text-only --model-dir <weights> --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8091 (starts bin/winnow-server; POST /v1/systemone).

measured.source: author README (BH latency shown on the board page)

variants.expected_speed: Author measured about 0.15-0.2 s for a four-question request cold-cache on RTX 5070 Ti; board latency for Q8 is on the Winnow page.
variants.notes: Q8_0 GGUF 12.67 GB; author's memory guide 12.8-14.8 GiB at 8K context. Only the prebuilt sm_120 (Blackwell) Linux build is supported by this installer.
